implementation_semantics.inputs: Existing accepted structural history, frontier metadata, broker-native structural signatures, opportunity map, information-gain ranking, and current EUR200 feasibility evidence.
output_artifacts: prospective frozen scope or explicit prerequisite failure

decision.pre_economic_next_action: Deterministically construct and audit the candidate pair graph from the accepted 41-representative 13W M5 history and current Pepperstone EUR200 feasibility index. For each candidate, verify synchronized observations, sufficient overlap, residual stationarity, stable hedge estimation, half-life, spread volatility, session independence, margin feasibility, and transaction-cost observability. Freeze the surviving adaptive breadth and exact pair identities only after all gates pass; do not open an economic outcome in this step.
decision.scope_method: Build an adaptive, frontier-relative candidate graph from eligible post-exclusion symbols, then retain only structurally disjoint pairs or small groups spanning distinct broker-native signatures, liquidity/session characteristics, and non-economic market classes.
selection_constraints: Exclude all consumed identities and historical outcome-exposed evidence.
Do not use observed economic outcomes for scope selection.
Do not select REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED or CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE.
Do not assume a fixed panel size.
Require exact broker symbol names and EUR200 margin survivability before any later economic authorization.

next_research_state.next_action: Construct and validate an adaptive RELATIVE_VALUE_COINTEGRATION candidate graph, then prospectively freeze only the broker-feasible structurally independent scope.
required_evidence: pairwise data sufficiency and synchronized-history audit
Pepperstone exact-symbol, transaction-cost, and EUR200 margin-feasibility audit

objective.goal: Select a distinct, non-economic relative-value research wave from the complete eligible frontier using structurally diverse, broker-feasible instruments.
objective.information_gain_rationale: RELATIVE_VALUE_COINTEGRATION is open, distinct from the temporarily unavailable regime and carry families, and can test cross-instrument dependency structure using the accepted 13W M5 history without reopening consumed identities. Pairwise breadth, residual stability, half-life, session overlap, and transaction-cost realizability provide information not captured by prior univariate or directional screens.
